verdict.rationale: A government tax and customs portal could plausibly publish a test environment for its machine channels, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only shows citizen-facing portal pages (notifications, login, service categories, outage notices) and a 404 for llms.txt. Nothing documents a public sandbox, test endpoint, or end-to-end test environment for any machine channel.

support.subject: As a developer, a public sandbox or test environment for the service's machine channel is documented — I can exercise the rail end to end before touching production
